text:
My experience getting filler injections for my penis with Dr. Beer was painless. This is my third time getting it done. The first time I drove to Phuket because Dr. Beer was only in Krabi for one day. Dr. Beer is very friendly and gives great advice. He solves the problem directly, solving all my sexual problems for sure. There are always interesting promotions. I've spent hundreds of thousands of baht and still haven't gotten to touch it, but I guarantee that if I come back often, it will be as big as my arm! 🥰🥰
P.S. I recommend the Flore Max 1400 brand. It's painful but worth it.
And another thing, the Step 2 filler is really good. The doctor gave me a sachet to try, and I saw great results, using it 5-6 times a day, and it was fully erect every time.
